raw_segments.text: He put the glass to his lips and drank at one gulp.
He reeled, staggered, clutched at the table and held on, staring with injected eyes, gasping
And as I looked there came, I thought, a change.
His face became suddenly black and the features seemed to melt and alter.
And the next moment, I had sprung to my feet and leaped back against the wall, my arms
raised to shield me from that prodigy.
